interpretation: Frozen h=2048 met both DEV gates (6 h abrupt recall 1.00; unmatched/wk 2.48) without a latched-only signature under the declared heuristics. On DIAG (diagnostic only): unmatched/wk fell to 0.88 and sensor-alarm% to 6.3, but useful 6 h abrupt sensitivity collapsed to 0/3 (delays 10.0, 17.75, 91.75 h — still counted under the registered 7-day window). The 0–2 h shifted null observed 0 matches (frac >= obs = 1.00). Union occupancy remained high (87%) with a very long episode (3416 h), so workload thinning is not a clean timing-preserving success. Threshold calibration here does not preserve declared useful event timing while reducing nuisance.
recommendation: **No-go:** calibrated h loses useful six-hour abrupt sensitivity on DIAG.
